value: Phase 7. Adds 68 cultivars from the 2026-08-30 Hill County research report, taking the catalogue from 35 to 103 plant types and plant_region from 64 to 139 rows. New categories: Radish, Carrot, Pumpkin, Cilantro, Chives, Kale, Asian greens, Brussels sprouts, Chinese cabbage, Watermelon, Tomatillo, Zinnia, Snapdragon, Viola, Gomphrena. Four cultivars in the report were already in the catalogue from the AgriLife recommended-cultivar list (Okra Clemson Spineless, Pepper Cayenne, Pepper Serrano, Tomato Roma) and are NOT restated here, so their verified AgriLife rows and windows stand. Kc for the ornamentals and the tomatillo are FAO-56 group analogues, named per row; DTM for the coded Johnny's hybrids is a type norm and carries confidence=generic.
